roadmap.title: Finish the Rise story and quest boards
roadmap.description: Use one hunter for Village, Hub, Arena, Apex, and HR 100 progression; unlock hidden standalone Apex quests through their Rampages.

roadmap.title: Clean up Kamura systems and base-game grinds
roadmap.description: Layer camps, relics, endemic life, Buddy systems, crafting, counters, scrolls, and lottery rolls over the 1,000-monster and crown routes.

roadmap.title: Finish the Sunbreak campaign and launch quest lists
roadmap.description: Move the same hunter to Elgado, clear Master Rank story quests, Followers, Support Surveys, Arena, and every launch-version quest through MR 100.

roadmap.title: Complete Elgado exploration and facilities
roadmap.description: Finish Jungle and Citadel camps, messages, endemic life, Buddy Recon, crafting, requests, NPC conversations, and other Sunbreak side systems.

roadmap.title: Advance Anomaly Research and Risen hunts
roadmap.description: Use Anomaly Investigations to combine afflicted kills, Research Level, Bahari coins, Qurious Crafting, and the 1,000 Master Rank monster counter.

roadmap.title: Finish crowns and claim both meta-awards
roadmap.description: Use guaranteed crown quests first, save successful hunts with Finish or Return from Quest, then close remaining lottery and long-counter gaps.

achievements.description: Granted for banishing an Apex in the Rampage. Its blade is riddled with battle scars.
achievements.summary: Repel @enemy{Apex Arzuros} in the 4-star Hub urgent Rampage @loc{The Blue Apex}.

guide.context: Rampage installations and counter signals are introduced before this urgent, and multiplayer help is optional rather than required.

steps.text: Progress Low Rank Gathering Hub key quests until @loc{The Blue Apex} appears as the 4-star urgent.
Complete the Rampage objectives and repel @enemy{Apex Arzuros} at the final gate.

achievements.description: A hanging scroll from Master Hojo, depicting your victory over Wind Serpent Ibushi.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Wind Serpent Ibushi} in the 6-star Hub urgent Rampage @loc{Serpent God of Wind}.

guide.context: This urgent is reached through High Rank Hub progression after the 4-star and 5-star key quests.

steps.text: Clear the required High Rank Hub key quests until @loc{Serpent God of Wind} becomes available.
Finish the Rampage and defeat @enemy{Wind Serpent Ibushi}.

achievements.description: Awarded for unlocking lots of camps. Each of its nicks and grooves tells a story.
achievements.summary: Discover every sub-camp site on the five base-game maps and complete the merchant requests that construct them.

guide.context: Finding a site only unlocks its request; the camp is not counted until the corresponding request is completed back in Kamura.

steps.text: Explore each base-game locale until every sub-camp discovery message appears.
Return to @npc{Kagero the Merchant}, accept each camp-construction request, and supply its requested materials or monster kills.
Revisit the locale map and confirm every discovered camp is available for fast travel.

achievements.description: The mark of a peerless hunter, conferred only to those who have earned a lot of awards.
achievements.summary: Earn the other 49 base-game Guild Card awards on the same hunter.

guide.context: Steam achievements mirror Guild Card awards, so splitting progress between characters prevents the meta-award from seeing one complete set.

steps.text: Use the same hunter to earn all 49 other base-game Guild Card awards.
Open the Guild Card award page and confirm the other 49 base-game awards are present.

achievements.description: A trinket given to new hunters who have proved themselves capable.
achievements.summary: Complete the first @loc{Kamura Village tutorial quest} on one hunter.

guide.context: All Guild Card award achievements must be earned on the same character, so keep one main hunter for the entire completion run.

steps.text: Create or load the single hunter who will earn the full Guild Card award set.
Accept and complete the opening tutorial quest from @npc{Hinoa} in Kamura Village.

achievements.description: A prize for vanquishing Magnamalo. This blade has led Kamura for generations.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Magnamalo} in the 5-star Village urgent quest @loc{Comeuppance}.

guide.context: Comeuppance is part of normal Village progression and becomes available after clearing the preceding key quests and urgents.

steps.text: Advance Kamura Village quests until Hinoa offers the 5-star urgent quest @loc{Comeuppance}.
Accept Comeuppance and hunt @enemy{Magnamalo} to complete the quest.

achievements.description: Received upon defeating Ibushi and Narwa. Depicts the two serpents leading the Rampage.
achievements.summary: Clear @loc{Serpent Goddess of Thunder}, the 7-star Hub urgent, by defeating @enemy{Thunder Serpent Narwa}.

guide.context: The award represents defeating both serpents; Ibushi is completed earlier during Hub progression, and Narwa finishes the required pair.

steps.text: Complete the 7-star Hub key quests that follow Ibushi.
Accept @loc{Serpent Goddess of Thunder} and defeat @enemy{Thunder Serpent Narwa}.

achievements.description: A decorative fan awarded to those who vanquished the crimson-glowing threat to the village.
achievements.summary: Reach @mechanic{HR 100} and defeat @enemy{Crimson Glow Valstrax} in @loc{The Crimson Glow}.

guide.context: Hunter Rank is uncapped after the Narwa urgent, so later quests and cleanup hunts can supply the rank points needed for HR 100.

steps.text: Defeat Narwa to uncap Hunter Rank, then complete quests until reaching @mechanic{HR 100}.
Accept the 7-star Hub quest @loc{The Crimson Glow} and defeat @enemy{Crimson Glow Valstrax}.

achievements.description: The mark of a hunter who has attempted some of the toughest quests around—and won.
achievements.summary: Complete every Village quest, then clear the final Village quest @loc{Advanced: The Veteran’s Gala}.

guide.context: The final Village challenge appears after the preceding Village list is complete. If Elder Fugen has not offered it, finish the Hub story through Thunder Serpent Narwa and speak with him again.

steps.text: Clear every available Village quest and confirm each Village rank has its completion check.
If @loc{Advanced: The Veteran’s Gala} is still unavailable, defeat @enemy{Thunder Serpent Narwa} in the Hub story and speak with @npc{Elder Fugen}.
Accept @loc{Advanced: The Veteran’s Gala} from the Village quest list and complete its multi-monster hunt.

achievements.description: Mark of a hunter who has bested Infernal Springs' most arduous challenges.
achievements.summary: Complete @loc{Those Crowned Apex} in the Infernal Springs after unlocking the Apex finale.

guide.context: The normal unlock route requires HR 100, the five Advanced Hub quests, Proof of Power, and prior hunts of Apex Rathalos, Apex Zinogre, and Apex Mizutsune; joining another player’s posted finale can bypass those unlock prerequisites.

steps.text: Reach HR 100 and complete the five newly available @loc{Advanced} Hub quests.
Complete @loc{Proof of Power} and ensure you have hunted @enemy{Apex Rathalos}, @enemy{Apex Zinogre}, and @enemy{Apex Mizutsune} at least once, including their Rampage unlocks.
Complete @loc{Those Crowned Apex} in the Infernal Springs.

achievements.description: A souvenir from the Guild for completing many low rank quests.
achievements.summary: Complete every Low Rank Gathering Hub quest, excluding Event Quests.

guide.context: Village quests are not part of this certificate; use the blue completion check on each Low Rank Hub tier to identify unfinished quests.

steps.text: Open the Gathering Hub quest counter and clear every quest in the Low Rank Hub tiers.
Confirm each Low Rank Hub tier has its completion check; Event Quests are not required.

achievements.description: A souvenir from the Guild for completing many high rank quests.
achievements.summary: Complete every High Rank Gathering Hub quest, excluding Event Quests.

guide.context: Standalone Apex hunts only appear after that Apex has first been defeated as a Rampage target, so a blue check can mean a hidden Apex quest is still locked.

steps.text: Clear every visible High Rank Hub quest and all six standalone Apex hunts.
If a tier remains incomplete, defeat the missing Apex as the final target of its Rampage, then clear the newly unlocked standalone quest.
Confirm every High Rank Hub tier has its completion check; Event Quests are excluded.

achievements.description: A souvenir from the Guild for completing many Rampage quests.
achievements.summary: Complete 50 @mechanic{Rampage Quests} on one hunter.

guide.context: Joined Rampages count, and the Guild Card tracks completed Rampages for checking progress.

steps.text: Accept or join Rampage Quests from the Hub.
Finish 50 Rampages and verify the total on the Guild Card.

achievements.description: A souvenir from the Guild for completing many Arena quests.
achievements.summary: Clear all six base-game @loc{Arena Quests}; the clear rank does not matter.

guide.context: Arena quests unlock after the corresponding normal hunts: Kulu-Ya-Ku; Barroth; Royal Ludroth and Nargacuga; Barioth; Rajang; and Volvidon, Basarios, and Bazelgeuse.

steps.text: Hunt each required arena monster in a Village or Hub quest to unlock all six Arena Quests.
Speak with @npc{Master Utsushi} in the Gathering Hub and clear Arena Quests 1 through 6 with any rank.

achievements.description: Awarded for completing 50 quests in the Shrine Ruins. Made from Spiritwood branches.
achievements.summary: Complete 50 quests in the @loc{Shrine Ruins} on one hunter.

guide.context: Quests joined through multiplayer also count, and crown, relic, endemic-life, and monster-hunt cleanup can be routed through this locale to avoid a separate grind.

steps.text: Choose quests or Expedition Tours set in the @loc{Shrine Ruins}.
Complete 50 quests in the Shrine Ruins; use the Guild Card award list to confirm when the counter finishes.

achievements.description: Awarded for completing 50 quests in the Frost Islands. A relic encased in primeval ice.
achievements.summary: Complete 50 quests in the @loc{Frost Islands} on one hunter.

guide.context: Quests joined through multiplayer also count, and crown, relic, endemic-life, and monster-hunt cleanup can be routed through this locale to avoid a separate grind.

steps.text: Choose quests or Expedition Tours set in the @loc{Frost Islands}.
Complete 50 quests in the Frost Islands; use the Guild Card award list to confirm when the counter finishes.

achievements.description: Awarded for completing 50 quests in the Flooded Forest. Was found buried under rubble.
achievements.summary: Complete 50 quests in the @loc{Flooded Forest} on one hunter.

guide.context: Quests joined through multiplayer also count, and crown, relic, endemic-life, and monster-hunt cleanup can be routed through this locale to avoid a separate grind.

steps.text: Choose quests or Expedition Tours set in the @loc{Flooded Forest}.
Complete 50 quests in the Flooded Forest; use the Guild Card award list to confirm when the counter finishes.

achievements.description: Awarded for completing 50 quests in the Sandy Plains. A peculiar silver cactus ring.
achievements.summary: Complete 50 quests in the @loc{Sandy Plains} on one hunter.

guide.context: Quests joined through multiplayer also count, and crown, relic, endemic-life, and monster-hunt cleanup can be routed through this locale to avoid a separate grind.

steps.text: Choose quests or Expedition Tours set in the @loc{Sandy Plains}.
Complete 50 quests in the Sandy Plains; use the Guild Card award list to confirm when the counter finishes.

achievements.description: Awarded for completing 50 quests in the Lava Caverns. Glitters a red-blue mélange.
achievements.summary: Complete 50 quests in the @loc{Lava Caverns} on one hunter.

guide.context: Quests joined through multiplayer also count, and crown, relic, endemic-life, and monster-hunt cleanup can be routed through this locale to avoid a separate grind.

steps.text: Choose quests or Expedition Tours set in the @loc{Lava Caverns}.
Complete 50 quests in the Lava Caverns; use the Guild Card award list to confirm when the counter finishes.

achievements.description: A wreath received from the villagers as thanks for taking on their many requests.
achievements.summary: Complete 100 Kamura requests, including repeatable @mechanic{Optional Subquests}.

guide.context: Both named villager requests and Optional Subquests from Hinoa or Minoto advance the same total, so fill all five optional slots before ordinary hunts.

steps.text: Accept five easy Optional Subquests from @npc{Hinoa} or @npc{Minoto} before each quest.
Turn in completed Optional Subquests and finish named villager requests until the combined total reaches 100.

achievements.description: Awarded for performing 1000 Wiredashes. Spins smoothly in the wind.
achievements.summary: Perform 1,000 @mechanic{Wiredashes} on one hunter.

guide.context: Wiredashes made during normal traversal count, so using Wirebugs instead of running during every quest minimizes cleanup.

steps.text: Hold the Wirebug aim control and use the Wiredash inputs while exploring or hunting.
Continue until 1,000 Wiredashes have registered.

achievements.description: Awarded for riding Canynes many times. Worn in odd places from use on countless voyages.
achievements.summary: Spend a cumulative 10 hours riding a @npc{Palamute}, then dismount, change area, or finish a quest to trigger the award.

guide.context: The timer can advance while mounted in Kamura Village, but the award does not pop during the ride itself; a fresh mount or transition forces the game to check the total.

steps.text: Bring a Palamute or use the village Palamute and mount it.
Accumulate 10 hours while seated on Palamutes across play sessions.
After crossing 10 hours, dismount and mount again, change area, or complete a quest.

achievements.description: Awarded for discovering many Great Wirebug launch points. Sports a nice relevant design.
achievements.summary: Place Great Wirebugs at every @loc{Jewel Lily} launch point on the five base-game maps.

guide.context: Senior Hunter Hanenaga gives exactly enough Great Wirebugs after his requests; white launch-point icons are unassigned and orange-yellow icons are complete, and some points must be reached in midair or on another map layer.

steps.text: Speak with @npc{Senior Hunter Hanenaga} beside the Kamura house and complete his requests after Magnamalo and Apex Arzuros.
On each locale and map layer, filter the map for white Jewel Lily icons.
Reach every icon and assign a @item{Great Wirebug}, including launch chains that require a midair placement.

achievements.description: Awarded for gathering 500 Hunting Helpers. Features a beautiful depiction of them.
achievements.summary: Gather 500 @item{Hunting Helpers} during quests or expeditions.

guide.context: Hunting Helpers are temporary endemic-life tools such as beetles, toads, and spiders; collecting one from the field advances the counter even if it is not used.

steps.text: Open a locale map and change its category to @mechanic{Other Endemic Life}.
Route through nearby Hunting Helper icons and pick up each helper.
Repeat the route across quests or expeditions until 500 helpers have been gathered.

achievements.description: Awarded for gathering 1000 Golden and Gilded Spiribugs. Shines much like they do.
achievements.summary: Collect 1,000 @item{Golden Spiribugs} in Low Rank and @item{Gilded Spiribugs} in High Rank.

guide.context: The two Spiribug variants share one counter, so collect them along traversal routes before engaging quest targets.

steps.text: Run Low Rank or High Rank quests and follow routes containing Golden or Gilded Spiribugs.
Pass through every Spiribug on the route, finish or return from the quest to preserve progress, and repeat until 1,000 are collected.

achievements.description: Awarded for finding many Old Messages. Adorned with a tasteful pattern.
achievements.summary: Collect all 60 @item{Old Messages}, comprising 12 Relic Records in each base-game locale.

guide.context: The Notebook under Hunter’s Notes tracks every numbered record separately and includes the five Rampage Messages obtained alongside each locale’s ten regular records.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Hunter’s Notes > Notebook} and note the missing entries for each locale.
Collect each locale's ten numbered Relic Records and two Rampage Messages. Check Lava Caverns and Sandy Plains, then Flooded Forest, Frost Islands, and Shrine Ruins.
Reopen the Notebook and confirm all 60 entries are filled.

achievements.description: Awarded for catching many fish. Feels familiar in your hands. One cast, one catch!
achievements.summary: Catch these 19 fish with the rod: Big Combustuna, Brocadefish, Combustuna, Crimsonfish, Flamefin, Gastronome Tuna, Goldenfish, Goldenfry, Great Flamefin, Great Gastronome Tuna, Great Whetfish, King Brocadefish, Platinumfish, Popfish, Scatterfish, Speartuna, Supreme Brocadefish, Sushifish, and Whetfish.

guide.context: Argosy acquisitions do not count. Platinumfish, Great Gastronome Tuna, Supreme Brocadefish, and Speartuna require High Rank; Armored Bream and Springnight Carp are excluded.

steps.text: Fish at Shrine Ruins Area 6 for Goldenfry, Crimsonfish, Goldenfish, and High Rank Platinumfish.
Fish at Shrine Ruins Area 13 for both Combustuna sizes and both Gastronome Tuna sizes.
Fish at Lava Caverns Area 1 for Scatterfish, Sushifish, Popfish, both Flamefin sizes, both Whetfish sizes, and all three Brocadefish sizes.
Catch High Rank Speartuna at Lava Caverns Area 3 and confirm each fish is present in the item list.

achievements.description: Awarded for cooking a welldone steak 30 times. Good job, and well done!
achievements.summary: Cook 30 @item{Well-done Steaks} with the BBQ Spit in quests or expeditions.

guide.context: Each successful cook consumes Raw Meat; remove the steak at the musical timing cue rather than early or late.

steps.text: Carry at least 30 @item{Raw Meat} into an Expedition Tour.
Use the @item{BBQ Spit} and stop each cooking animation at the correct cue to make a Well-done Steak.
Repeat until 30 Well-done Steaks have been cooked.

achievements.description: Awarded for photographing many Hunting Helpers. Proof you've expanded your hunter horizons.
achievements.summary: Photograph every base-game @item{Hunting Helper} and register each picture in Hunter’s Notes.

guide.context: The required set runs from Poisontoad through Aurortle; the Other Endemic Life map filter reveals helper locations during a quest.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Hunter’s Notes > Endemic Life} and check which Hunting Helper entries lack a registered photo.
During quests, filter the map to Other Endemic Life, equip the camera, and photograph every missing helper.
Assign each clear photo to its matching Hunter’s Notes entry.

achievements.description: Awarded by one enthusiastic researcher for photographing many Rare Creature.
achievements.summary: Photograph the five rare creatures: Snow-faced Fox, Monksnail, Quetzalcobra, Regitrice, and Hellbill.

guide.context: Their fixed opportunities are Shrine Ruins Area 5 at night, Frost Islands Area 8 at night, Flooded Forest Areas 2–3 by day, Sandy Plains Area 12 by day, and Lava Caverns Areas 11–14 at night.

steps.text: Start an expedition at the required day or night setting for each locale.
Reach each rare creature’s area, wait for it to appear, and take a clear camera photo.
Register all five photos in @mechanic{Hunter’s Notes > Endemic Life}.

achievements.description: Awarded for photographing many Endemic Lifeforms. Now you're a Guild-recognized researcher!
achievements.summary: Photograph every base-game endemic-life species and register every picture in Hunter’s Notes.

guide.context: This superset includes all Hunting Helpers and rare creatures plus ordinary endemic life; Prism Spiribird appears only in the Arena and Infernal Springs, while Golden Spiribug is Low Rank and Gilded Spiribug is High Rank.

steps.text: Complete the Copper and Silver Ecologist photo sets first.
Compare @mechanic{Hunter’s Notes > Endemic Life} against every remaining species and photograph each missing entry.
Use the Arena or Infernal Springs for Prism Spiribird and both Low and High Rank locales for the two Spiribug variants.

achievements.description: Awarded for earning 1,000,000 zenny. Heavy with impressively intricate goldwork.
achievements.summary: Earn a cumulative 1,000,000 @item{zenny} on one hunter.

guide.context: The counter tracks lifetime earnings rather than current funds, so spending zenny on equipment does not reduce progress.

steps.text: Complete quests, sell trade-in items, and collect rewards on the same hunter.
Continue until lifetime zenny earnings reach 1,000,000.

achievements.description: Awarded for accumulating 100,000 Kamura Points. Gleams with polish despite great use.
achievements.summary: Earn a cumulative 100,000 @item{Kamura Points} on one hunter.

guide.context: The counter uses lifetime points earned, not the current balance, so Argosy and canteen spending is safe.

steps.text: Gather account items, complete quests, and use optional subquests that award Kamura Points.
Continue until lifetime Kamura Point earnings reach 100,000.

achievements.description: Awarded for hiring 50 Buddies. We a-purr-eciate your fur-iendly patronage!
achievements.summary: Hire 50 Buddies through @npc{Iori the Buddy Handler}; dismissed Buddies still count.

guide.context: The roster does not need to hold 50 at once, allowing the same hire-and-dismiss loop to respect the capacity limit.

steps.text: Speak with @npc{Iori} in the Buddy Plaza and hire available Palicoes or Palamutes.
Dismiss unneeded hires when the roster fills, then hire replacements.
Continue until 50 total Buddy hires have registered.

achievements.description: Proof of having sent the Meowcenaries out on a quest 100 times.
achievements.summary: Collect 100 stage rewards from @mechanic{Meowcenaries}, equivalent to 20 complete five-stage trips.

guide.context: Dispatching and immediately recalling a team gives no credit; recalling after completed stages credits only those finished stages.

steps.text: Send a Buddy team on a five-stage Meowcenaries route.
Complete quests until the return notification appears, then collect all five stage rewards.
Repeat full trips until 100 stage rewards have been collected.

achievements.description: Awarded for raising various support-type Palicoes to their maximum levels.
achievements.summary: Raise one Healer, Assist, Fight, Bombardier, and Gathering @npc{Palico} to level 50.

guide.context: Only Palicoes have support types; the Buddy Dojo can train inactive Palicoes while the active pair gains quest experience.

steps.text: Hire at least one Palico of each of the five support types.
Place inactive Palicoes in the Buddy Dojo and take others on quests.
Raise one Palico of every support type to level 50.

achievements.description: Awarded for collecting a lot of Palamute Gear. Daily maintenance is what will make it last!
achievements.summary: Obtain all six base-game @item{Palamute Gear} rewards from Canyne Master Inukai’s Palamute requests.

guide.context: Find Inukai beside Hinoa in Kamura's Steelworks. Further Village and Hub progress causes him to offer additional requests.

steps.text: Speak with @npc{Canyne Master Inukai} whenever a request icon appears.
Complete all six requests whose titles or objectives concern Palamutes.
Collect each request reward so every Palamute Gear item is registered.

achievements.description: Awarded for forging many valuable weapons and armor. Made from premium materials.
achievements.summary: Forge five total rarity-7 weapons or armor pieces in any combination.

guide.context: Upgrades that produce rarity-7 equipment count; the five pieces do not need to share a set or equipment type.

steps.text: Reach High Rank materials and unlock rarity-7 forge or upgrade options.
At the Smithy, create or upgrade five weapons or armor pieces to rarity 7.

achievements.description: Awarded for forging many a layered armor. Its variegated hues are simply captivating.
achievements.summary: Forge five different @item{layered armor} pieces after reaching HR 8.

guide.context: Layered armor unlocks at HR 8 and consumes Outfit Vouchers; the game grants three vouchers initially and 7-star Hub quests can award more.

steps.text: Reach @mechanic{HR 8} to unlock layered armor forging.
Obtain at least five @item{Outfit Vouchers}.
Forge five distinct layered armor pieces at the Smithy.

achievements.description: Awarded for obtaining many Petalaces. It fills rooms with a delightful floral aroma.
achievements.summary: Clear @loc{May Fire Quell Fury} and @loc{A Blaze Among Beasts}, the two 7-star Hub quests that award the remaining Petalaces.

guide.context: The award is checked after returning from the second quest because those two quests provide the remaining Petalaces.

steps.text: Unlock both 7-star Hub quests through normal High Rank progression.
Complete @loc{A Blaze Among Beasts}.
Complete @loc{May Fire Quell Fury} and return to Kamura.

achievements.description: Awarded for obtaining many Switch Skills, a feat of both mental and bodily discipline.
achievements.summary: Obtain all three base-game @mechanic{Switch Skills} for each of the 14 weapon types.

guide.context: Each weapon’s set comes from story progress, its named 4–6-star High Rank Hub quest, and having owned eight distinct weapon nodes of that type. Upgrades count as distinct nodes; avoid Defender weapons for this counter.

steps.text: Progress Village and Hub quests until the first Switch Skill set is awarded.
Own eight distinct weapon-tree nodes for each weapon type by forging and upgrading weapons.
Complete every High Rank Hub quest named for a weapon type, such as @loc{Grasp the Great Sword}, and speak with @npc{Master Utsushi} for the skills.

achievements.description: Awarded for helping Yomogi. You can almost hear the Tea Dealers' chanting when looking at it.
achievements.summary: Unlock every base-game @item{Dango recipe} through story progress, requests, and the required Village and Hub quests.

guide.context: The non-story checklist includes four canteen requests, four Village quests, and six Hub quests, so a complete quest board alone may not cover every request reward.

steps.text: Complete the requests @loc{Bunny Dango – with Eggs!}, @loc{Thick, Gooey Dango}, @loc{A Dango a Day}, and @loc{Only the Good Eggs}.
Complete Village quests @loc{Supply Run}, @loc{Getting Back the Groceries}, @loc{Comeuppance}, and @loc{The Secret Ingredient}.
Complete Hub quests @loc{Dango Duty}, @loc{Totally Not Cool, Kulu!}, @loc{Do It for the Dango!}, @loc{A Quartet of Horns}, @loc{Can’t Kill It with Fire}, and @loc{Seared Situation}.

achievements.description: Awarded for collecting many decorations and hanging scrolls. Remember to lock up!
achievements.summary: Collect all required base-game room carvings, hanging scrolls, and twelve lottery trinkets.

guide.context: The set requires the 12 carvings awarded for all 60 Relic Records, story scrolls, one Argosy scroll after ten hunts of every base-game large monster except Narwa the Allmother, and all six Apexes; Thunder Serpent Narwa is required.

steps.text: Collect all 60 Relic Records and claim the 12 carvings from @npc{Kagero}.
Unlock the five story scrolls and hunt each required large monster ten times, then buy every available monster scroll through @mechanic{Housekeeper > Room Customization > Hanging Scrolls}.

Whenever the Market announces a sale, use the lottery. The required prizes are Crystal Cluster, Pure Machalite, Moofy Doll, Felyne Daruma, Mini Submarine, Mini Toadversary, Cohoot Lottery, Golden Hojo Cast, Kamura Twins, Bombadgy Pot, Wheeled Canyne Toy, and Lucky Felyne.

achievements.description: Awarded to connoisseurs of Cohoot outfits. Perfect for storing your avian apparel.
achievements.summary: Obtain the three unlockable @npc{Cohoot outfits} in addition to the default outfit.

guide.context: The outfits come from Mihaba after Comeuppance, Komitsu after the first Rampage, and Canyne Master Inukai after the Flying Billboards request.

steps.text: Complete @loc{Comeuppance} and collect Mihaba the Apprentice’s Cohoot outfit.
Complete the first Rampage and collect Komitsu the Sweettooth’s outfit.
Complete @loc{Flying Billboards} for Canyne Master Inukai and collect the final outfit.

achievements.description: Awarded for talking to many of Kamura's citizens. Feels like walking on a carpet of cloud.
achievements.summary: Speak to every named human, Palico, and Palamute in @loc{Kamura Village}, including hidden and intermittently available residents.

guide.context: Commonly missed targets include Fugashigi behind the house scroll, Sekirei in the Training Area, Badum and Tish while default Hub music plays, and NPCs selected with the Switch Target control.

steps.text: Systematically speak to every resident in the house, Steelworks, Gathering Hub entrance and interior, Hub second floor, Buddy Plaza, and Training Area.
Use @mechanic{Switch Target} when characters overlap, restore default Hub music for Badum and Tish, and speak through the house scroll to Fugashigi.
Recheck rotating residents such as Senari, Suzukari, Kajika, Zenchi, and Goka until the award registers.

achievements.description: Awarded for hunting 1,000 large monsters.
achievements.estTime: about 200 hours, heavily overlapping other goals
achievements.summary: Hunt or capture 1,000 large monsters outside Rampages on one hunter.

guide.context: Captured monsters count. In Rampages, only the final target counts; the Guild Card’s page-two Slain plus Captured totals equal actual progress because those counters are separate.

steps.text: Prioritize required crowns, ten-hunt scroll counts, quests, and Anomaly work before dedicated farming.
Check Guild Card page 2 and add the separate @mechanic{Slain} and @mechanic{Captured} totals.
Continue completing fast large-monster hunts until the combined total reaches 1,000.

achievements.description: Awarded for hunting 5 monsters in 1 Expedition Tour.
achievements.summary: Hunt five large monsters during one @mechanic{Expedition Tour}; repeated species count.

guide.context: Expeditions continuously replace hunted monsters and have no ordinary quest target, allowing five hunts in one uninterrupted tour.

steps.text: Start an Expedition Tour in any base-game locale.
Hunt or capture a large monster, wait for another large monster to enter the locale, and continue.
Complete the fifth large-monster hunt before selecting Return from Quest.

achievements.description: Awarded for riding many different monsters.
achievements.summary: Initiate @mechanic{Wyvern Riding} on 100 monsters.

guide.context: The description’s wording does not require 100 different species; every successful mount contributes to the same total.

steps.text: Use Silkbind attacks, Puppet Spiders, or monster-on-monster damage to place a large monster in a mountable state.
Mount the monster when the Wyvern Riding prompt appears.
Repeat across quests until 100 mounts have registered.

achievements.description: Awarded for registering many miniature crownsized monsters.
achievements.summary: Register a miniature crown for every required base-game monster, including all six Apexes but excluding Ibushi and Narwa.

guide.context: A crown is saved after the monster is hunted if you leave with Return from Quest; Abandon Quest discards it. Guaranteed-crown Event Quests should be exhausted before random farming.

steps.text: Check @mechanic{Hunter’s Notes > Large Monsters} and list every required species without a miniature crown.
Clear guaranteed miniature-crown Event Quests for applicable monsters, then farm high-chance quests for the remainder.
After obtaining a needed crown, finish the quest or use @mechanic{Return from Quest}; never use Abandon Quest.

achievements.description: Awarded for registering many gold crown-sized monsters.
achievements.summary: Register a gold crown for every required base-game monster, including all six Apexes but excluding Ibushi and Narwa.

guide.context: Large-crown progress follows the same save rule as miniature crowns, and multiple guaranteed Event Quests cover part of the roster.

steps.text: Check @mechanic{Hunter’s Notes > Large Monsters} and list every required species without a gold crown.
Clear guaranteed large-crown Event Quests for applicable monsters, then farm high-chance quests for the remainder.
Finish or Return from Quest after each needed crown so the record is saved.

achievements.description: An official request for Kamura's hunter. Awarded for collaboration with Elgado Outpost.
achievements.estTime: part of the 20–30 hour Sunbreak campaign
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Daimyo Hermitaur} in the MR 1 urgent quest @loc{Uninvited Guest}.

guide.context: Uninvited Guest is the first Sunbreak urgent and establishes the route from Kamura to Elgado Outpost on the same hunter.

steps.text: Install Sunbreak and complete the 7-star Hub urgent @loc{Serpent Goddess of Thunder} by defeating @enemy{Thunder Serpent Narwa}; this unlocks the Sunbreak opening and @loc{Uninvited Guest}.
Hunt @enemy{Daimyo Hermitaur} and complete the urgent quest to begin Master Rank progression in Elgado.

achievements.description: Binoculars giving a clear view of far-off targets. Awarded to staunch investigators.
achievements.estTime: part of the 20–30 hour Sunbreak campaign
achievements.summary: Clear @loc{Scarlet Tengu in the Shrine Ruins}, the MR 1 promotion urgent, by defeating @enemy{Blood Orange Bishaten}.

guide.context: The completed quest is later displayed as The Assault of the Scarlet Tengu, but its first-clear title is Scarlet Tengu in the Shrine Ruins and it advances the hunter to MR 2.

steps.text: Clear the required MR 1 key quests until @npc{Chichae} offers @loc{Scarlet Tengu in the Shrine Ruins}.
Accept the urgent and defeat @enemy{Blood Orange Bishaten} in the Shrine Ruins to reach MR 2.

achievements.description: Protects the wearer from the harshest environments. Awarded for hunting the Garangolm.
achievements.estTime: part of the 20–30 hour Sunbreak campaign
achievements.summary: Hunt @enemy{Garangolm} during the Sunbreak Master Rank story.

guide.context: Garangolm is a mandatory campaign target and the award appears after its assigned urgent quest.

steps.text: Accept Master Rank key and urgent quests from @npc{Chichae} in Elgado.
Complete the required story assignment until the named target or campaign milestone is cleared.

achievements.description: A fountain pen with a blue feather gifted by Fiorayne. Awarded for hunting the Lunagaron.
achievements.estTime: part of the 20–30 hour Sunbreak campaign
achievements.summary: Hunt @enemy{Lunagaron} during the Sunbreak Master Rank story.

guide.context: Lunagaron follows Garangolm in mandatory campaign progression and requires no optional quest condition.

steps.text: Accept Master Rank key and urgent quests from @npc{Chichae} in Elgado.
Complete the required story assignment until the named target or campaign milestone is cleared.

achievements.description: A desk flag proving the owner's distinguished service. Awarded for slaying Malzeno.
achievements.estTime: part of the 20–30 hour Sunbreak campaign
achievements.summary: Slay @enemy{Malzeno} during the Sunbreak Master Rank story.

guide.context: Malzeno is the central campaign urgent before the final Master Rank story sequence.

steps.text: Accept Master Rank key and urgent quests from @npc{Chichae} in Elgado.
Complete the required story assignment until the named target or campaign milestone is cleared.

achievements.description: An official thank-you letter. For hunters who contributed greatly to the Kingdom's peace.
achievements.estTime: part of the 20–30 hour Sunbreak campaign
achievements.summary: Complete Sunbreak’s main Master Rank story and restore peace to the Kingdom.

guide.context: This story award follows the launch campaign finale; title-update monsters are not required.

steps.text: Accept Master Rank key and urgent quests from @npc{Chichae} in Elgado.
Complete the required story assignment until the named target or campaign milestone is cleared.

achievements.description: A souvenir from the Guild for completing many Master Rank quests.
achievements.summary: Complete every launch-version Master Rank quest through the MR 100 unlocks.

guide.context: Sunbreak launch quests can require MR 100; quests featuring title-update monsters are excluded from this certificate.

steps.text: Advance the campaign, raise Master Rank to 100, and clear every launch-version Master Rank quest at Chichae’s counter.
Ignore quests centered on free title-update monsters when checking the required launch list.
Confirm every required Master Rank tier has its completion mark.

achievements.description: Awarded for befriending a fledgling Snowy Cohoot from Elgado. Looks tiny, but has a big appetite.
achievements.summary: Feed the fledgling @npc{Snowy Cohoot} in Elgado between quests until it befriends you, usually after 15–20 quest cycles.

guide.context: The white fledgling is separate from the Cohoot nest; feeding opportunities reset as quests are completed.

steps.text: Find the fledgling Snowy Cohoot in @loc{Elgado Outpost}.
Feed it once whenever the interaction is available, then complete another quest.
Repeat the feed-and-quest cycle until the award appears.

achievements.description: A souvenir from the Guild for completing even more Arena quests.
achievements.summary: Clear every Sunbreak @loc{Master Rank Arena Quest}; the clear rank does not matter.

guide.context: Arena quests appear after their corresponding monsters have been encountered in ordinary Master Rank hunts.

steps.text: Progress the Sunbreak roster until all Master Rank Arena Quests are available from @npc{Arena Master Arlow}.
Clear each Master Rank Arena Quest once with any weapon and any completion rank.

achievements.description: Awarded for completing many Follower Quests to mark deep village-Outpost ties.
achievements.summary: Complete every launch-version @mechanic{Follower Quest}.

guide.context: Follower Quests unlock through story progression and NPC requests; title-update additions are excluded from the launch award requirement.

steps.text: Accept Follower Quests from the Elgado and Kamura followers as their request icons appear.
Clear every launch-version Follower Quest and collect each completion conversation.

achievements.description: Proof of having completed many Support Surveys. Soar away into a clear blue sky.
achievements.summary: Complete every launch-version @mechanic{Support Survey}.

guide.context: Support Surveys use unlocked Followers in repeatable Master Rank hunts, but the award requires each original survey entry to be cleared once.

steps.text: Unlock Followers by completing their Follower Quests.
Open Support Surveys at Chichae’s counter and clear every launch-version survey.

achievements.description: Awarded for deepening bonds with many Followers. Sharing this cup fosters friendship.
achievements.summary: Deepen bonds with all required Followers by completing their Follower Quest chains.

guide.context: The bond award is obtained naturally while clearing every launch Follower Quest because each character’s chain establishes their availability.

steps.text: Accept each Follower’s requests and complete that character’s quest chain.
Continue until every launch-version Follower has joined Support Surveys and the award registers.

achievements.description: A depiction of the dreadful Qurio. Awarded for completing numerous Anomaly Quests.
achievements.summary: Complete every launch-version @mechanic{Anomaly Quest} unlocked from MR 10 through MR 100.

guide.context: Anomaly Quests begin at MR 10; monsters and quests added by free title updates are excluded from this launch award.

steps.text: Reach @mechanic{MR 10} and clear each Anomaly Quest tier as it unlocks.
Raise Master Rank through MR 100 to reveal the final launch Anomaly Quests.
Clear every required launch-version Anomaly Quest once.

achievements.description: Awarded for completing 50 quests in the Jungle. A talisman to protect you on your travels.
achievements.summary: Complete 50 quests in the @loc{Jungle}.

guide.context: Master Rank story, Follower, Support Survey, Anomaly, crown, and collection work in this locale all advances the counter.

steps.text: Select quests or expeditions set in the @loc{Jungle}.
Complete 50 total quests in the Jungle.

achievements.description: Awarded for completing 50 quests in the Citadel. A charm praying for your good health.
achievements.summary: Complete 50 quests in the @loc{Citadel}.

guide.context: Master Rank story, Follower, Support Survey, Anomaly, crown, and collection work in this locale all advances the counter.

steps.text: Select quests or expeditions set in the @loc{Citadel}.
Complete 50 total quests in the Citadel.

achievements.description: Awarded for fulfilling various requests in Kamura and/or Elgado.
achievements.summary: Complete all 46 named requests added by Sunbreak across Kamura Village and Elgado Outpost.

guide.context: Optional Subquests do not count. The Hunter Info request list preserves completed titles, so compare it with the complete 46-request roster instead of relying on NPC markers alone.

steps.text: Complete these A–C requests: A Fine, Fire-Breathing Buddy; A Great Gift for Your Buddies; Amber Brilliance; Assist Upgrade Campaign!; Bag a Barioth; Bag a Bazel, Yeah?; Black Hell Hunter’s Hint; Bombardier Upgrade Campaign!; Buddy Commitment; Chevalier’s Sleepy Solution; Citadel Sub-Camp Security; Combo Wizardry; Cool Coal Discovery!; Cursed Buddy Gear?; Cutesy Crab Pose?.

Complete these C–G requests: Edgy Arrows; Elder Dragon Delights; Espinas Entanglement; Fighter Upgrade Campaign!; Fur Requiting Kogarashi; Gatherer Upgrade Campaign!; Giant in the Frost Islands?; Good Guts for Gunlances; Gore Magala Mission.

Complete these G–R requests: Grueling Training Ground; Hand-Me-Down Trial; Healer Upgrade Campaign!; In Cahoots for Cohoot Pics; Jungle Sub-Camp Security; Lagombi in the Moonlight; New Mask Mission; No YOU Get ’Em!; Not a Mer-Made-Up Story!; Palamute Gear Power Up; Prized Mushroom Picker; Red Hell Hunter’s Hint; Researcher’s Request.

Complete these R–V requests: Resplendent Red Request; Spelunker Maintenance Mission!; Sprout Search; Tacky Photo; Top-Notch Training Tools; Tough Training Tools; Twisted Elixir; Ultimate Upgrade; Violent Nature.

achievements.description: An easy-to-deploy camping kit. Awarded for unlocking a lot of camps in the Jungle and Citadel.
achievements.summary: Discover and construct every sub-camp in the @loc{Jungle} and @loc{Citadel}.

guide.context: As in the base game, discovering a suitable site only unlocks its merchant request; completing that request actually constructs the camp.

steps.text: Explore the Jungle and Citadel until every sub-camp discovery message appears.
Accept the resulting construction requests from the Elgado merchant and complete their objectives.
Confirm every camp appears as a fast-travel destination on both maps.

achievements.description: Awarded for discovering a lot of Great Wirebug launch points in the Jungle and the Citadel.
achievements.summary: Place Great Wirebugs at every @loc{Jewel Lily} in the Jungle and Citadel.

guide.context: Fran the Stalwart gives the first supply and the remainder after requests to photograph Daimyo Hermitaur’s claws and Garangolm’s arms; some sites require midair placement, hidden tunnels, or a Large Barrel Bomb route.

steps.text: Speak with @npc{Fran the Stalwart} in Elgado’s Market and complete both monster-part photo requests.
Filter each map layer for white Jewel Lily markers and reach the hidden or midair sites.
Assign a Great Wirebug to every white marker in both locales.

achievements.description: Awarded for discovering a lot of Old Messages in the Jungle and Citadel. An unspoiled antique.
achievements.summary: Collect all 20 Sunbreak @item{Old Messages}: ten Relic Records in the Jungle and ten in the Citadel.

guide.context: The Notebook under Hunter’s Notes tracks each numbered Jungle and Citadel record separately.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Hunter’s Notes > Notebook} and check missing Jungle and Citadel records.
Collect Jungle Messages 1–10 and Citadel Messages 1–10.
Confirm all 20 entries are filled in the Notebook.

achievements.description: A smart frame awarded for photographing many creatures in the Citadel and Jungle.
achievements.summary: Photograph every required Jungle and Citadel endemic-life species and assign the photos in Hunter’s Notes.

guide.context: The set includes both new rare creatures and locale species such as Gold and Ruby Wirebugs, Marionette Spider, Starburst Bug, Slicecrab, Spearsquid, and Thornytoad. Keep the underlying photo files present until the award is checked.

steps.text: Use @mechanic{Hunter’s Notes > Endemic Life} to find every Jungle or Citadel entry without a photo.
Photograph both rare creatures and every missing listed species in the two locales.
Assign each photo and keep the game’s screenshot files intact until the award registers.

achievements.description: Its refinement exceeds human capability. Awarded for obtaining even more Switch Skills.
achievements.summary: Obtain every Sunbreak Switch Skill after reaching @mechanic{MR 4}, with the base-game Master’s Black Belt already complete.

guide.context: Elgado grants one new set soon after arrival and the remaining set at MR 4; the Red Sash may wait for all base-game Switch Skills if Master’s Black Belt is still missing.

steps.text: Obtain the first Sunbreak Switch Skill set during the Elgado introduction.
Reach MR 4 and collect the second Sunbreak set.
Complete all base-game Switch Skills for every weapon if @item{Master’s Black Belt} has not already unlocked.

achievements.description: A pretty great winged helmet. Awarded for forging even more valuable weapons and armor.
achievements.summary: Forge five rarity-10 weapons or armor pieces in any combination.

guide.context: Rarity-10 equipment uses afflicted materials obtained after the Sunbreak story through Anomaly Quests.

steps.text: Complete the Sunbreak campaign and unlock Anomaly Quests at MR 10.
Farm the afflicted materials required by five rarity-10 equipment recipes.
Forge or upgrade five weapons or armor pieces to rarity 10.

achievements.description: A helm with golden hollows and blue wings. Awarded for forging even more valuable layered armor.
achievements.summary: Forge five different rarity-10 @item{layered armor} pieces with Outfit Voucher+ materials.

guide.context: Outfit Voucher+ comes from post-story Master Rank and Anomaly content; ordinary lower-rarity layered armor does not satisfy this Sunbreak award.

steps.text: Complete the Sunbreak story and collect at least five @item{Outfit Voucher+}.
At the Smithy, choose five distinct layered armor pieces whose recipes are rarity 10.
Forge all five pieces.

achievements.description: Awarded for collecting even more trinkets and wall hangings. Won't budge, no matter what.
achievements.summary: Collect every required Sunbreak room statue, hanging scroll, and lottery trinket from the launch roster.

guide.context: The set combines Jungle and Citadel Relic Record statues, story scrolls, scrolls purchased after ten hunts of each launch Sunbreak monster, launch lottery prizes, the Gargolda photo statue, and the Flag Ornament.

steps.text: Collect all Jungle and Citadel Relic Records and photograph Gargolda to unlock the associated statues.
Slay every launch Sunbreak large monster ten times and buy every new monster scroll from the Argosy; captures do not advance the ten-hunt scroll condition.
Win the launch Sunbreak lottery statues and Lucky Prizes, then verify the room inventory includes the Flag Ornament and all story scrolls.

achievements.description: Super popular in the Tea Shop! Awarded for helping make new dango, even in far-off Elgado.
achievements.summary: Unlock every Sunbreak @item{Dango recipe} by completing all quests and named requests that reward new dango.

guide.context: Recipe rewards are split between normal Master Rank quests and NPC requests, so collect request rewards after finishing their objectives.

steps.text: Accept every Elgado request that lists a dango recipe as its reward.
Complete all Master Rank quests that unlock new dango.
Return to the canteen and confirm every Sunbreak recipe is available.

achievements.description: Awarded to dango connoisseurs for using many Hopping Skewers. Add honey to sweeten things up!
achievements.summary: Use @mechanic{Hopping Skewers} for 20 canteen meals before quests.

guide.context: The counter advances when the Hopping Skewers option is enabled for the meal; the chosen dango combination does not need to be identical each time.

steps.text: At the canteen, toggle @mechanic{Hopping Skewers} on before ordering.
Eat the meal and complete or leave for a quest.
Repeat for 20 meals with Hopping Skewers enabled.

achievements.description: Toys of a cuddling Felyne and Canyne. Awarded to avid instructors at the Buddy Dojo.
achievements.summary: Complete the five Palico Upgrade Campaigns and Nagi’s four Buddy Dojo requests to unlock every Sunbreak Buddy-training feature.

guide.context: The five campaigns unlock Secret Support Moves. Nagi’s requests add level-5, level-10, and level-15 Support Move swaps plus Buddy Skill Lesson.

steps.text: Complete @loc{Healer Upgrade Campaign!}, @loc{Assist Upgrade Campaign!}, @loc{Fighter Upgrade Campaign!}, @loc{Bombardier Upgrade Campaign!}, and @loc{Gatherer Upgrade Campaign!}; each requires three completed Master Rank quests with the matching Palico support type.
Complete @loc{Tough Training Tools} by delivering one Hermitaur Hardclaw and one Ceanataur Hardclaw.
Complete @loc{Buddy Commitment} by raising three Buddies to Skill Memory 8.
Complete @loc{Grueling Training Ground} by slaying eight Master Rank Rachnoids in the Lava Caverns, then complete @loc{Top-Notch Training Tools} by delivering two Rajang Wildpelts.

achievements.description: A necklace that ended up with your Buddy. Awarded for trading with Letters of Introduction.
achievements.summary: Obtain 50 red-background Backroom Deal items through the Argosy.

guide.context: Nagi can send three Buddies on trades using Letters of Introduction; the item boxes must be emptied periodically or new trade items stop arriving.

steps.text: Speak with @npc{Nagi the Buddy Agent} in Elgado’s Market and assign three Buddies to Argosy trades.
Enable @mechanic{Backroom Deals} for all three routes.
Complete quests, collect the trade boxes before they fill, and continue until 50 red-background items have been received.

achievements.description: A simple flute with far-reaching tones. Awarded to those who have found a lot of Recon destinations.
achievements.summary: Discover every @loc{Buddy Recon} destination in the Jungle and Citadel.

guide.context: Recon points are once-per-quest fast-travel destinations and must be found in the field before a Buddy can be deployed there.

steps.text: Explore both Jungle and Citadel and interact with every Buddy Recon marker.
At the Buddy Plaza or Elgado Buddy facilities, assign a Buddy to the discovered Recon points.
Confirm every destination in both locales is listed.

achievements.description: A tasty treat for hard-working Canynes. Awarded for teaching your Canyne lots of techniques.
achievements.summary: Complete every Sunbreak request that rewards a new @item{Palamute Gear} or Palamute technique.

guide.context: The techniques are delivered through Elgado’s Buddy request chain as Master Rank advances.

steps.text: Accept every Elgado request concerning Palamutes or Palamute equipment.
Complete each objective and collect its Buddy-related reward.
Check the Palamute Gear and technique lists after the final request.

achievements.description: A cute and colorful painted acorn. Awarded for having lots of Buddies with outstanding Skill Memory.
achievements.summary: Use @item{Eurekacorns} to maximize Skill Memory on ten total Buddies; Palicoes and Palamutes both count.

guide.context: Eurekacorns can come from the Elgado Cohoot nest after each fifth quest, Master Rank Meowcenaries, and occasional Optional Subquests.

steps.text: Collect Eurekacorns from the Elgado Cohoot nest and Master Rank Meowcenaries while completing quests.
At the Buddy Dojo, spend Eurekacorns to fill every Skill Memory slot on a Buddy.
Repeat until ten combined Palicoes and Palamutes have maximum Skill Memory.

achievements.description: Ignore wind as you whip through the world. Awarded for performing many Switch Skill Swaps.
achievements.summary: Perform exactly 100 @mechanic{Switch Skill Swaps} during quests.

guide.context: Only the in-hunt swap between Red and Blue Switch Skill Swap Scrolls counts; editing loadouts at a box does not.

steps.text: Equip valid Switch Skill Swap Scroll loadouts.
During a quest, use the Switch Skill Swap input to alternate between the Red and Blue Scrolls.
Repeat until 100 in-field swaps have registered.

achievements.description: Awarded to those who rode various monsters with the power of Morphed Wirebugs.
achievements.summary: Use both the @item{Gold Wirebug} and @item{Ruby Wirebug} to initiate Wyvern Riding at least once each.

guide.context: The two Morphed Wirebugs appear in Sunbreak locales and apply different riding bonuses, but each only needs to contribute to one mount.

steps.text: Collect a @item{Gold Wirebug} and mount a monster while its effect is active.
Collect a @item{Ruby Wirebug} and mount a monster while its effect is active.

achievements.description: Wow! A whole bag awarded for obtaining samples of items from all over the place.
achievements.summary: Receive 20 special item samples from @npc{Pingarh the Sailor} at Elgado’s Docks.

guide.context: Pingarh offers a gift only when the cargo boxes beside him display one of the special-goods states, so check him after quests rather than repeatedly in one visit.

steps.text: After each completed quest, visit @npc{Pingarh the Sailor} at the Elgado Docks.
When the nearby boxes show special goods, speak with Pingarh and accept his item sample.
Repeat until 20 gifts have been received.

achievements.description: Sandals for exploring. Awarded for talking with lots of people in the Outpost.
achievements.summary: Speak to every required human, Palico, and Palamute in @loc{Elgado Outpost}.

guide.context: Some residents arrive later, Kamura visitors are intermittent, and Hayate and Raiden require Switch Target beside Nagi; accepting a visitor’s Follower Quest may satisfy their interaction.

steps.text: After finishing the story, sweep the House, Central Plaza, Market, Docks, Tea Shop, and Command Post and speak to every named resident and animal.
Use @mechanic{Switch Target} near @npc{Nagi} to select Hayate the Brave and Raiden the Gallant.
Recheck late and rotating residents, including Bahari, Doctor Tadori, Hinoa, Minoto, Master Utsushi, Sir Jae, Unabara, and Supy.

achievements.description: Awarded for hunting 100 large master rank monsters.
achievements.summary: Hunt or capture 100 large monsters in Master Rank quests.

guide.context: Captures count, while the completed Master Rank quest total is only an approximation because multi-target quests can add several monsters.

steps.text: Finish all Master Rank quest, crown, ten-hunt scroll, and Anomaly goals before dedicated farming.
Continue completing fast Master Rank large-monster hunts until 100 kills or captures have registered.

achievements.description: Awarded for hunting 500 large master rank monsters.
achievements.summary: Hunt or capture 500 large monsters in Master Rank quests.

guide.context: Captures count, while the completed Master Rank quest total is only an approximation because multi-target quests can add several monsters.

steps.text: Finish all Master Rank quest, crown, ten-hunt scroll, and Anomaly goals before dedicated farming.
Continue completing fast Master Rank large-monster hunts until 500 kills or captures have registered.

achievements.description: Awarded for hunting 1000 large master rank monsters.
achievements.summary: Hunt or capture 1000 large monsters in Master Rank quests.

guide.context: Captures count, while the completed Master Rank quest total is only an approximation because multi-target quests can add several monsters.

steps.text: Finish all Master Rank quest, crown, ten-hunt scroll, and Anomaly goals before dedicated farming.
Continue completing fast Master Rank large-monster hunts until 1000 kills or captures have registered.

achievements.description: Awarded for registering almost all miniature crown-sized monsters.
achievements.summary: Register miniature crowns for 59 of the game’s 78 crown-capable monsters. The excluded targets are Amatsu, Chaotic Gore Magala, Flaming Espinas, Gaismagorm, Gold Rathian, Lucent Nargacuga, Narwa the Allmother, Primordial Malzeno, Risen Chameleos, Risen Crimson Glow Valstrax, Risen Kushala Daora, Risen Shagaru Magala, Risen Teostra, Seething Bazelgeuse, Silver Rathalos, Thunder Serpent Narwa, Velkhana, Violet Mizutsune, and Wind Serpent Ibushi.

guide.context: The 59-monster set combines every base-game crown target with these 16 launch-Sunbreak monsters: Daimyo Hermitaur, Blood Orange Bishaten, Aurora Somnacanth, Scorned Magnamalo, Garangolm, Shogun Ceanataur, Magma Almudron, Lunagaron, Astalos, Espinas, Gore Magala, Seregios, Pyre Rakna-Kadaki, Malzeno, Shagaru Magala, and Furious Rajang.

steps.text: Complete the base-game miniature-crown set, including all six Apex monsters.

Obtain a miniature crown for each launch-Sunbreak target: Daimyo Hermitaur, Blood Orange Bishaten, Aurora Somnacanth, Scorned Magnamalo, Garangolm, Shogun Ceanataur, Magma Almudron, Lunagaron, Astalos, Espinas, Gore Magala, Seregios, Pyre Rakna-Kadaki, Malzeno, Shagaru Magala, and Furious Rajang.
After a needed crown, finish the quest or choose @mechanic{Return from Quest}; Abandon Quest discards the record.

achievements.description: Awarded for registering almost all gold crown-sized monsters.
achievements.summary: Register gold crowns for 59 of the game’s 78 crown-capable monsters. The excluded targets are Amatsu, Chaotic Gore Magala, Flaming Espinas, Gaismagorm, Gold Rathian, Lucent Nargacuga, Narwa the Allmother, Primordial Malzeno, Risen Chameleos, Risen Crimson Glow Valstrax, Risen Kushala Daora, Risen Shagaru Magala, Risen Teostra, Seething Bazelgeuse, Silver Rathalos, Thunder Serpent Narwa, Velkhana, Violet Mizutsune, and Wind Serpent Ibushi.

guide.context: The 59-monster set combines every base-game crown target with these 16 launch-Sunbreak monsters: Daimyo Hermitaur, Blood Orange Bishaten, Aurora Somnacanth, Scorned Magnamalo, Garangolm, Shogun Ceanataur, Magma Almudron, Lunagaron, Astalos, Espinas, Gore Magala, Seregios, Pyre Rakna-Kadaki, Malzeno, Shagaru Magala, and Furious Rajang.

steps.text: Complete the base-game gold-crown set, including all six Apex monsters.

Obtain a gold crown for each launch-Sunbreak target: Daimyo Hermitaur, Blood Orange Bishaten, Aurora Somnacanth, Scorned Magnamalo, Garangolm, Shogun Ceanataur, Magma Almudron, Lunagaron, Astalos, Espinas, Gore Magala, Seregios, Pyre Rakna-Kadaki, Malzeno, Shagaru Magala, and Furious Rajang.
After a needed crown, finish the quest or choose @mechanic{Return from Quest}; Abandon Quest discards the record.

achievements.description: Awarded for slaying your first afflicted monster.
achievements.summary: Slay the first @enemy{Afflicted Monster} in an Anomaly Quest after reaching MR 10.

guide.context: Anomaly Quests unlock at MR 10 after the Sunbreak story and introduce the Qurio core-burst mechanic.

steps.text: Complete the Sunbreak campaign and reach @mechanic{MR 10}.
Accept an Anomaly Quest and slay its Afflicted Monster target.

achievements.description: Awarded for slaying 100 afflicted monsters.
achievements.summary: Slay 100 @enemy{Afflicted Monsters} in Anomaly Quests or Investigations.

guide.context: This counter overlaps Anomaly Research leveling and Investigation Coin farming, so use required Investigations instead of repeating low-value Anomaly Quests.

steps.text: Unlock Anomaly Investigations and select targets that advance research or Bahari requests.
Slay the Afflicted Monster target in 100 completed Anomaly Quests or Investigations.

achievements.description: An extremely detailed report, the result of impressive hard work researching the Anomaly.
achievements.summary: Raise @mechanic{Anomaly Research Level} to 50 by completing Anomaly Investigations.

guide.context: Investigation completions grant research experience based on level and conditions, so higher-level valid investigations accelerate the climb.

steps.text: Reach MR 10 and unlock Anomaly Investigations.
Complete investigations near the highest available level until Anomaly Research Level reaches 50.

achievements.description: Awarded only to those who have completed tasks designated by the Research Lab to be the most difficult.
achievements.summary: Complete an @mechanic{Anomaly Investigation} at level 100 after raising the research cap.

guide.context: The investigation itself must be level 100; merely reaching Anomaly Research Level 100 does not complete the task.

steps.text: Continue Anomaly Investigations until research level 100 and a level-100 investigation are available.
Post and complete the level-100 Anomaly Investigation.

achievements.description: Bahari's handmade toy that walks when wound up. Proves you frequent the Anomaly Lab.
achievements.summary: Spend a cumulative 3,000 @item{Investigation Coins} at Bahari’s Anomaly Research Lab.

guide.context: Bahari pays coin bundles for completing sets of ten requested investigations, with later payouts increasing; the award tracks coins spent rather than held.

steps.text: Complete the target investigations requested by @npc{Bahari} to earn Investigation Coins.
At the Anomaly Research Lab, purchase materials until cumulative coin spending reaches 3,000.

achievements.description: Awarded for Augmenting many weapons via Qurious Crafting. Specially developed to handle dangerous afflicted materials.
achievements.summary: Enable @mechanic{Qurious Weapon Crafting} on five different weapons.

guide.context: Qurious Crafting unlocks after the first Anomaly Investigation and uses afflicted materials; applying the initial enablement to a weapon counts.

steps.text: Complete the first Anomaly Investigation to unlock Qurious Crafting.
At the Smithy, choose five different eligible weapons and enable Qurious Crafting on each.

achievements.description: Awarded for Augmenting a lot of armor via Qurious Crafting. These tools can work even the most brittle of materials.
achievements.summary: Enable @mechanic{Qurious Armor Crafting} on five different armor pieces.

guide.context: The initial augmentation unlock on each eligible piece is sufficient; further rerolls are not required for the counter.

steps.text: Complete the first Anomaly Investigation to unlock Qurious Crafting.
At the Smithy, augment five different eligible armor pieces through Qurious Armor Crafting.

achievements.description: Awarded for slaying your first Risen monster.
achievements.estTime: about 1 hour after the rank requirement
achievements.summary: Slay one @enemy{Risen Elder Dragon}.

guide.context: Risen monsters unlock through high Master Rank and later Anomaly content; any available Risen species satisfies the first-kill award.

steps.text: Raise Master Rank until a Risen Elder Dragon quest becomes available.
Accept the Risen quest and slay its target.

achievements.description: Awarded for slaying 15 Risen monsters.
achievements.summary: Slay 15 @enemy{Risen Elder Dragons} across quests or investigations.

guide.context: Repeated hunts of the same Risen species count, so choose the fastest comfortable Risen target after completing unique quests.

steps.text: Unlock at least one Risen Elder Dragon quest or investigation.
Slay Risen Elder Dragons in 15 completed hunts.

achievements.description: The mark of a great hero, who has acquired a large number of awards.
achievements.summary: Earn the other 49 Sunbreak Guild Card awards on the same hunter.

guide.context: Sunbreak adds exactly 50 Steam achievements, and its meta-award requires the complete DLC award set on one character.

steps.text: Use the same hunter to earn all 49 other Sunbreak Guild Card awards.
Open the Guild Card award page and confirm the other 49 Sunbreak awards are present.
